newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek cash rates sit idle, ecu/drachma stable.
newsitem.headline: Greek cash rates sit idle, ecu/drachma stable.

text.p: Greek money rates and forex swaps were unmoved in late lacklustre trade with the central bank draining overnight money at 12.40 percent and ecu/drachma holding steady as the greenback broke above 1.50 marks.

"Trading has been sleepy today and rates are holding morning levels," a money market dealer at a foreign bank said. "The main event is the continued strengh of the dollar which pierced resistance at 1.50 marks and the steadiness of ecu/drachma in the local market."
There was very little action at the central bank's fixing, forex dealers said.
"The market seems to discount no major changes in economic policy after the election no matter who is elected," he said.
Early elections will be held September 22 but the market has taken a positive attitude towards them on the ground that the winner will have no option but to follow Greece's EU convergence plan.
The mark was quoted at 159.28/33 drachmas from Tuesday's 159.290 fix, the dollar at 239.38/48 drachmas from 239.490 and the Ecu at 301.26/36 from 301.240 drachmas.
